completion_basis: preoutcome judgment was frozen before outcome access and independently accepted
outcome access was separately authorized and mechanically settled by the custodian
postoutcome investor judgment was formed after comparing observed FY2024 facts with the frozen judgment
all six axes record treatment changes, confidence or range changes, or explicit non-change
one outcome-caused next-case research behavior change is recorded

method_utility.reason: A single-arm blind episode can complete a real feedback turn but cannot estimate comparative method utility, calibration improvement, efficiency, or investment effect.

material_treatment_change.reason: No axis crossed its frozen treatment category; the outcome changed confidence, the normal-earnings upper bound, risk composition, and research specificity.

axis_feedback.outcome_processing: Ten of eleven disclosed volume axes did not decline and persistent expense burden fell, but three-segment profit fell about 12.0% and adjusted parent profit fell about 8.5%. No qualifying structural carrier was identified and the adverse profit thresholds were not both breached.
axis_feedback.unknown_localization: The missing price, mix, unit-contribution, cost, or customer carrier limits causal attribution only; it does not erase the observed profit decline or the company judgment.

axis_feedback.outcome_processing: FY2024 adjusted parent profit was CNY 3.163bn, three-segment profit was CNY 3.132bn, Sinotrans-DHL net profit fell about 20.9%, and group equity-method income fell about 17.2%. The lower bound was not breached, while the prior upper bound lost support.
axis_feedback.unknown_localization: Segment-level subsidy attribution and the Sinotrans-DHL structural carrier remain local unknowns; they determine attribution and placement within the range, not whether group earnings exist.

axis_feedback.outcome_processing: Both same-definition group cash proxies remained positive and improved; parent investment-income cash was CNY 3.359bn and no material remittance restriction was disclosed. Parent-distributable owner cash, complete NCI attribution, and maintenance-versus-expansion capex remain open.
axis_feedback.unknown_localization: Open parent scope prevents an upgrade but does not erase observed group cash.

axis_feedback.outcome_processing: Both group cash proxies were positive and issuer-defined net cash increased to CNY 1.813bn. A CNY 0.036bn expected credit loss on a charter-flight subsidy receivable is a real local carrier, but persistence and irreversibility were not established.
axis_feedback.unknown_localization: Credit-loss persistence remains local; parent cash access is not a gate to permanent-loss settlement.

axis_feedback.outcome_processing: Lower core and joint-venture earnings reduced the earnings-range upper bound, while stronger group cash and net cash offset a directional downgrade relative to the already conservative frozen reference state.

The action family stays rank one. It is refined to split the parent's CNY 3.359bn investment-income cash by source and close NCI distributions, maintenance capex, transfer restrictions, and cumulative FY2022-FY2024 parent-distributable owner cash.

postoutcome_investor_judgment.enterprise_view: Reported resilience remains but is weaker: broad volume growth did not convert into matched segment profit, the key joint venture's earnings and dividend contribution declined, while group cash and net cash improved. Use a CNY 2.8bn-CNY 3.2bn conservative normal-earnings range, conditional management credit, conditional owner cash, maintained permanent-loss constraint, and unchanged valuation direction relative to the frozen conservative state.

most_important_judgments.judgment: Scale growth did not demonstrate economic improvement.
most_important_judgments.mechanism: Ten of eleven volume axes did not decline, yet all three segment profits declined and aggregate segment profit fell about 12%; price, mix, unit contribution, and resource-intensity carriers are not disclosed.

most_important_judgments.judgment: Sinotrans-DHL remains valuable and cash-generative but no longer supports the old normal-earnings upper bound.
most_important_judgments.mechanism: Revenue fell about 8.6%, net profit about 20.9%, margin compressed, equity-method income fell about 17.2%, and dividends declined while transfer access and impairment evidence remained non-adverse.

most_important_judgments.judgment: Cash and net cash cushion permanent-loss risk without closing parent owner cash.
most_important_judgments.mechanism: OCF and both group cash proxies improved and net cash expanded, but parent-distributable cash, NCI attribution, and maintenance capex remain unclosed.

postoutcome_investor_judgment.strongest_counterargument: Revenue and most business volumes grew, expense burden and subsidy intensity fell, both group cash proxies and net cash improved, and Sinotrans-DHL still produced profit and dividends without impairment or transfer restriction. The profit decline may therefore be reversible mix or cycle noise rather than structural execution deterioration.

scenario_summary.optimistic: Same-boundary segment profit reaches at least CNY 3.7bn, adjusted parent profit at least CNY 3.4bn, subsidy-before unit economics improve, joint-venture earnings recover, and parent owner cash closes; management and valuation may move positive.
scenario_summary.base: Segment profit stays around CNY 3.1bn-CNY 3.4bn, adjusted parent profit remains within the CNY 2.8bn-CNY 3.2bn conservative range, joint-venture profit and dividends persist, and both group cash proxies stay positive; current treatments remain.
scenario_summary.pessimistic: Segment profit is at most CNY 3.0bn and adjusted parent profit below CNY 2.8bn with an identified carrier, or JV profit and equity income breach their adverse thresholds; earnings and valuation move down. Persistent negative group cash plus net-cash contraction tightens or blocks permanent loss.

flip_facts: Same-boundary segment profit of at least CNY 3.7bn and adjusted parent profit of at least CNY 3.4bn with improved subsidy-before unit economics would flip execution and valuation upward.
Segment profit at or below CNY 3.0bn and adjusted parent profit below CNY 2.8bn with an identified customer, pricing, cost, or credit carrier would flip execution and valuation downward.
Sinotrans-DHL net profit at or below CNY 2.8bn and group equity-method income at or below CNY 1.8bn with an identified adverse carrier would lower normal earnings and valuation.
Closed parent scope with at least CNY 2.0bn FY2024 parent-distributable owner cash and positive FY2022-FY2024 cumulative owner cash would upgrade owner cash.

Either same-definition group cash proxy negative for two periods with persistent credit or maintenance cash consumption and material net-cash contraction would tighten permanent loss; irreversibility lasting at least 12 months would make it thesis-blocking.

next_case_research_behavior_change.behavior: Before granting management-execution credit for business-volume or revenue growth, construct a same-responsibility-boundary bridge to recurring profit or unit economics. If the bridge is unavailable, record scale growth but freeze execution attribution.
next_case_research_behavior_change.outcome_trigger: In this episode, ten of eleven volume axes did not decline while three-segment profit fell about 12.0%.
